objective: Standardize candidate source-to-observation extraction while preventing any provider from writing canonical narrative state or converting uncertainty into fabricated certainty.

input.rights_rule: Provider input must be authorized by the extraction-calibration source policy.

hard_rules: A provider emits candidate observations only.
Every output binds to the exact source digest it consumed.
Confidence is calibration metadata, not prose quality.
Provider uncertainty may reduce coverage; it must not be normalized into an ASSERTED label merely to improve recall.
A provider may not infer author intent or publication authority.
A provider may not access hidden Book-Eval gold or bulk copyrighted reference bodies.
Canonical narrative-state materialization remains a separate validated downstream transition.
baseline_rule: The required no-model baseline abstains on every task. It exists to prove that low false-certainty alone is insufficient: zero-coverage/zero-recall must remain visible in the receipt.
next_provider_admission: A model or NLP provider may be added only after the provider-independent scorer and no-model baseline are green. Provider selection must be evaluated on source-held-out evidence, task-level metrics, ambiguity preservation, false certainty and calibration.
